decision: 5 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 2 for the 12 month period).
event_name: Document 52 Date 04 September 2022 Time 16:51 2022 DUTCH GRAND PRIX 01 - 04 September 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed multiple angles of video evidence. Car 5 rejoined the track after a pit stop just in front of HAM, who was about to lap Car 5. Blue flags (signals) were shown at multiple occasions before VET allowed the faster car past.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
team: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team
title: Offence Car 5 Ignoring Blue Flags
